arguments.text: A character vector or an object coerced to character.

origin.details: This operator is the same function as %s+%.
origin.example: cat(paste0("c(\"a\", NA) %stri+% c(\"b\", \"c\") returns ", paste(ifelse(is.na(c("a", NA) %stri+% c("b", "c")), "NA", c("a", NA) %stri+% c("b", "c")), collapse = ", "), ".\n"))

arguments.name: e1
arguments.text: A string, NA, a number, or a list of those.

arguments.name: e2
arguments.text: A string, NA, a number, or a list of those.

translation.details: stri_plus is s_plus, which calls stri_join with an empty separator.
translation.value: A list of strings. A missing element is NA.
translation.example:
shown = ", ".join("NA" if item is NA else item for item in stri_plus(["a", NA], ["b", "c"]))
print(f"stri_plus(['a', NA], ['b', 'c']) returns {shown}.")
